statement_summary: Cybersecurity Lead designated in writing
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment shared with the hazmat plan review
Annual independent control assessment; POA&M to closure
Annual check of TSA and FRA applicability
Security terms in vendor contracts
Keep security records at least 5 years
Unique accounts including dispatch consoles
MFA everywhere remote or privileged; hardware keys for admins and vendors
Same-day access removal at termination
Quarterly access reviews
No default passwords on any device
Vendor access on request through the jump host with session recording
Physical access to HQ, dispatch, towers, and onboard PTC housings
Report suspected incidents to dispatch within 1 hour
Report cyber attacks to TSA within 24 hours
Report unauthorized SSI release to TSA
Manual dispatch when movement-authority systems are suspect
Annual tabletop including a manual dispatch step
SSI stored, shared, marked, and destroyed per part 1520
Encrypt Restricted data and SSI at rest and in transit
Isolated immutable backups tested quarterly
Annual awareness training for all employees; phishing exercises; role-based training
No personal devices or USB media on operations equipment
Approved AI tools only; AI supplements required inspections
